issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
target_group: SC students pursuing post-matriculation courses in India

eligibility_rules.description: Belongs to a Scheduled Caste notified for the state/UT where permanently settled or domiciled
Passed matriculation or higher secondary or a higher examination
Parents' or guardian's income from all sources up to Rs 2,50,000 per year in the last financial year
Recognised post-matric course at an institution with an AISHE or UDISE code; not a second course at the same stage
Not holding another scholarship or stipend at the same time
Renewal: at least 75% attendance and satisfactory academic performance each year

benefits.component: Compulsory non-refundable fees (tuition etc.), via Freeship Card or DBT
benefits.amount: As fixed by the state fee committee

course_groups: Group 1: degree and PG professional courses (medicine, engineering etc.). Group 2: other professional courses (pharmacy, nursing etc.). Group 3: graduate and PG courses not in Groups 1 or 2 (BA, BSc, BCom etc.). Group 4: post-matric non-degree courses (Classes XI-XII, ITI, 3-year diploma).
required_documents: Income certificate issued by the authority the state designates
Bank account in the student's name, Aadhaar-seeded
documents_note: Documents may be verified automatically through DigiLocker or linked databases (para 13(d)).
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with Aadhaar and course details to get a Freeship Card (para 8.2)
On the day of admission, apply for the scholarship on the portal using the Freeship Card details (paras 9.1, 17.2)
The institution verifies the admission on the portal the same day (para 9.2)
Renewals are automatic if you are promoted and have at least 75% attendance (paras 9.3, 12.1)
payment: Direct to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account through DBT (para 11.1)
deadline_note: The guideline says the portals stay open throughout the year (para 11.4). Check the current cycle on NSP.
source_document: Guidelines for Post Matric Scholarships to SC students, March 2021 (uploaded Postmatric_SC.pdf)
open_items: Confirm 2026-27 rules on NSP, since the guideline validity ends 2025-26
